summary: Murf's Startup Incubator Program gives early-stage startups $1,500 in free Murf API (TTS/voice) credits for a 3-month period, one-time only. Overage beyond the credits is charged at $0.03 per 1,000 characters. Eligibility: under 10 years since incorporation, fewer than 100 employees, a fully functioning company website, and a valid use case for the Murf API. Applications are reviewed; the page gives 1–2 days in the process section and up to one week in the application FAQ. The application is a HubSpot form.
claim_steps: Fill the application form linked from murf.ai/startup-program ('Apply Now').
Meet criteria: under 10 years since incorporation, fewer than 100 employees, functioning company website, valid Murf API use case (no reselling/non-compliant use).
Wait for application review: the process section says 1–2 days, while the application FAQ says within one week. On approval the credit plan is activated and $1,500 added to your account.
